subject: [AMBER] cudaGetDeviceCount failed no CUDA-capable device is detected

messages.author: ABDELATIF MESSAOUDI
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I have compiled Amber22 with CUDA support in our Ubuntu 22,10, but when
*to run simulation, pmemd runs fine but I get the following error in
pmemd.cuda *
cudaGetDeviceCount failed no CUDA-capable device is detected
*Best regards *
*Abdelatif Messaoudi*
*LCMVAR, University of Batna 1, Algeria*
